comment: Per-tier exact-match targets and CI floors for the LaTeX extraction benchmark. `target` is the goal: 99.9% is claimed for pdfLaTeX with Computer Modern and AMS fonts only, so tiers set in other fonts (and scanned pages) have no target until their baselines are understood. `floor` is the gate: a run below it fails. Floors sit just under the measured rate (see BENCHMARK.md) and only move up. Since Phase 2 the extractor reads glyphs and rules from the PDF itself, so the result does not depend on the machine's fonts and a floor can sit within a point of the measurement. The `real-*` tiers hold equations from the source of openly licensed arXiv papers, set in Computer Modern by the benchmark harness, so they are inside the target. `heldout` lists the tiers of the held-out set (corpus-heldout/), which has targets but no floors: it is measured at phase gates, not gated in CI. Edited by hand; the corpus builder never touches this file. `real-inline-punct`, `real-display-numbered` and `real-display-dvips` set the real tiers' equations as a reader meets them: with the sentence's mark against the formula, with an equation number and a box as wide as the column, and through dvips and Ghostscript. `real-display-lm` sets them in Latin Modern, whose math fonts the extractor reads with the Computer Modern tables.
